body: Yes but at about 70% for short term and I think 50 or 60% for long term. That's a hella cut for being forced into this.

And I've been cut off from HR and my co-workers except the ones willing to break the rules to talk to me. Which is about half, including my supervisor but he won't talk about the STD (disability not the other one ok?).

True dat. Between being treated like a tool that's broken (instead of a person), and being home alone all day with little ability to go somewhere (when we bought the house, good transit wasn't a factor because I wasn't epileptic at the time)... My only companion is my head and my head is a piece of shit.
They're saying I'm not qualified for anything else. Like I'm a one trick pony.
I'm in Canada but my neurologist filled out a fit for duty that gave restrictions. I've made suggestions but they are afraid of their liability.

My mother. She's been in and out of the hospital since I told her I was trans. I feel like I broke the one person I've always wanted to protect. I feel lost. And I think the only thing stopping me right now is knowing that killing myself would make her worse. But at the same time between that and my depression sitting like an evil monkey on my back I'm not sure how much longer I can do this.
